name: organ_pedal
character: A pipe organ's low pedal: a sustained root and fifth that never leaves, the floor of the cue.
sources: KB cinematic-hybrid-scoring (a sustained organ or low-string bed, a pulse that keeps going, low brass at the turning points: per its section 2) | the part's job in the cue
ESTIMATE: azimuth, distance, level and EQ are starting values for this piece, not measurements

MEASURED: the pedal's 5th harmonic (about 367 Hz, an F#4) sat 18 Hz from the horn's F4 in the Bb bar and cochlear_roughness read the beating (0.076 against 0.070); STARTING VALUE: low-pass at 260 Hz, so the pedal is the floor of the cue and its upper harmonics do not collide with the theme
